info.title: meshy/meshy-n1
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "meshy/meshy-n1", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: The Comfy Router input schema for `meshy/meshy-n1`, Meshy's retexture operation with ai_model meshy-n1. It textures an existing mesh from one to four reference images and gives one 2k base color map. Send the mesh as input_task_id or model_url. Send the reference images as image_style_url (one front view) or as multiview_image_urls (one to four views, the first is the front view). Text prompts, PBR maps and 4k or 8k textures are not supported.

ai_model.description: The Meshy model to run. On the Comfy Router route this is supplied by the path (`/v2/models/meshy/{model}`) and may be omitted or sent as null; Router writes the path's model here after validation.

enable_original_uv.description: Use the original UV of the model instead of generating new UVs.

enable_pbr.description: meshy-n1 does not generate PBR maps, so only false is accepted.

image_style_url.description: One reference image, used as the front view. Supports jpg, jpeg, png and webp, or a base64 data URI. Do not send with multiview_image_urls.

input_task_id.description: The ID of a completed Meshy task whose mesh to texture. Required if model_url is not provided.

model_url.description: A publicly accessible URL or data URI to a 3D model. Supported formats glb, gltf, obj, fbx, stl. Required if input_task_id is not provided. At most 7,999,999 triangle faces.

multiview_image_urls.description: One to four reference images of the same object. The first image is the front view. Do not send with image_style_url.

target_formats.description: The model formats to generate. One or more of glb, obj, fbx, stl, usdz and 3mf.

texture_resolution.description: Texture resolution of the base color map. meshy-n1 supports 2k only.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for `meshy/meshy-n1`: the terminal `GET /proxy/meshy/openapi/v1/retexture/{task_id}` task document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL. `POST /proxy/meshy/openapi/v1/retexture` answers a `MeshyRetextureCreateResponse` handle whose `result` is the task id, and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished task document.
The textured model is in `model_urls`, at whichever formats the request produced. Read the one that is present. The 2k base color map is in `texture_urls[0].base_color`. `thumbnail_url` is a preview image, not the asset.
`status` is Meshy's own UPPERCASE vocabulary. `SUCCEEDED` is the one terminal success. `FAILED` and `CANCELED` reach a Router caller as a Comfy Router error with Meshy's reason in `task_error.message`.

MeshyRetextureModelUrls.description: Downloadable URLs to the textured 3D model files.

fbx.description: Downloadable URL to the FBX file.

glb.description: Downloadable URL to the GLB file.

mtl.description: Downloadable URL to the MTL material file for the OBJ file.

obj.description: Downloadable URL to the OBJ file.

stl.description: Downloadable URL to the STL file.

usdz.description: Downloadable URL to the USDZ file.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the task was created, in milliseconds.

expires_at.description: Timestamp of when the task result expires, in milliseconds.

finished_at.description: Timestamp of when the task was finished, in milliseconds. 0 if not finished.

image_style_url.description: The image input that was used to create the texturing task.

multiview_image_urls.description: The reference images that were used to create the texturing task.

preceding_tasks.description: The count of preceding tasks. Only meaningful when status is PENDING.

progress.description: Progress of the task. 0 if not started, 100 when succeeded.

started_at.description: Timestamp of when the task was started, in milliseconds. 0 if not started.

text_style_prompt.description: The text prompt that was used to create the texturing task.

texture_urls.description: An array of texture URL objects that are generated from the task.

thumbnail_url.description: Downloadable URL to the thumbnail image of the model file.

MeshyTaskError.description: Error object that contains the error message if the task failed.

MeshyTextureUrls.description: Texture URL object containing PBR maps.

base_color.description: Downloadable URL to the base color map image.

metallic.description: Downloadable URL to the metallic map image.

normal.description: Downloadable URL to the normal map image.

roughness.description: Downloadable URL to the roughness map image.
